name: EightPlayerCoop
description: Local co-op for up to 8 players on one PC. Every co-op screen (character and weapon selection, HUD, level-ups, shop, pause menu, end of run) gets a layout for 5-8 players; with 1-4 players the game looks exactly like vanilla.
